title: Iris's PlayerHeads
description: This Plugin is a recreation of Hoplite's Player heads system
body:
This mod is a recreation of hoplites well known player head mechanic! (or so UHC)
-- Whenever you kill a player or a player dies, theyre player head will drop on the ground.
-- Eating these heads give the player swiftness and regeneration for a short period of time!
-- You can upgrade these heads effects by crafting golden heads! 
-- Golden heads are crafted by a playerhead in the middle and have it surrounded in gold ingots!
(sort of like a golden apple)
